people: Yusuf (the coffee shop owner next door)
exchanges: ok so i know its late but i just got home from the bakery and i cant sleep because priya and i spent the whole closing shift arguing about whether we need a second oven and honestly i think shes right but i dont want to admit it
It sounds like she made a good case. What is holding you back?
money mostly i just put a Hobart on my own card last month the big floor one and my bank account is still crying about it
That is a big purchase so close to another one. Is the second oven urgent?
kind of because saturdays we run out of everything by 11 and people get grumpy
Running out early is a nice problem to have, but still a problem.
true lol anyway my kid Lena is asleep thank god she was up til ten doing a science fair thing with her dad
Sounds like a busy household tonight.
yeah and i didnt even get to watch my Arsenal tonight because of the shift which is probably good since they apparently lost again
Maybe missing it was a blessing.
haha yeah. oh and my uncle rafael called while i was icing cupcakes to tell me hes got gout again and the doctor told him no more red meat and he was so upset you would think someone died
That sounds painful, so maybe the diet change will help him.
he will never stick to it he loves steak more than he loves my aunt
Old habits are hard to change.
and THEN my great uncle ignacio got on the phone too because they live together now and he told me all about his shingles which i did not need to hear about in such detail
That sounds really uncomfortable for him, especially at his age.
so yeah two old men with two different miserable things lol i love them though
They are lucky to have someone who listens.
priya says hi by the way not really but she would
Hi to Priya too.
she's getting married in October and she wants me to make the cake which is terrifying because its for like 200 people
That is a big cake, but also a big compliment.
the ceremony is up in Niagara at some winery her fiances family owns so at least the wine will be free
Free wine at a winery wedding sounds hard to beat.
lol exactly. ok i should try to sleep i have to be up at 4
Good idea. Want to talk until you feel sleepy?
sure why not my brain is still going
What else is on your mind?
siobhan our new part timer is so good she picked up laminating in like two days
That is impressive for a new hire.
and she's learning Japanese on her lunch breaks, flashcards over her sandwich and everything
That is a very efficient lunch break.
wait sorry i just checked the group chat and priya moved the wedding to September because the winery was booked so not october, i had that wrong
Thanks for the update, that gives you a little less time for the cake.
ugh yeah one month less of panic practice
You have made plenty of cakes before, you will be fine.
i have been bouldering twice a week to deal with the stress honestly its the only thing that turns my brain off
Climbing is a good way to clear your head.
my forearms are destroyed though which is not great when you knead for a living
That is a tough combination.
lol yeah. ok what else. i think i need a vacation
Is there a slow week coming up when you could take a break?
no such thing in a bakery lol
Fair point, bakeries do not really have slow weeks.
the coffee guy next door yusuf brings us espresso every morning in exchange for day olds best trade ever
That is a great arrangement.
he was telling me hes obsessed with Severance and i have to watch it hes like on season two already
Sounds like he might pull you into it.
maybe this weekend if i survive saturday
Saturday will go fine, you have a system.
oh wait what was the thing my great uncle has, i want to send him a card
